AMBERDROP.realSource: Original sanctuary cat for the United States Oil Fund (USO). No real cat exists, so our own look text is the ground truth.
AMBERDROP.exactLook: A normal four-legged, sleek, photo-real domestic shorthair tortoiseshell with no white. The coat is mostly glossy jet-black (neutral black, not brown), with scattered, soft-edged honey-gold/amber tortie patches and brindling covering a minority of the coat, roughly 15-25%: a gold blaze on the forehead, gold on the cheeks, chest and legs, and flecks on the tail. The gold should not form regular tabby-like bands or hard-edged geometric blocks. The eyes are green-gold (yellow-green) and the nose is dark. It wears nothing.

AMRCAT.realName: AMR猫 (read 'AMR neko'; furigana えーえむあーる ねこ). The cat introduces itself: 'ボクはAMR猫であ～る' ('I am AMR Cat'). 'AMR Cat' is its direct English rendering.
AMRCAT.realSource: AMR猫, the drawn cat host of Pfizer Japan's children's YouTube video 'AMR（薬剤耐性）って知ってる？' about antimicrobial resistance, supervised by Prof. Kazuhiro Tateda of Toho University.
AMRCAT.exactLook: A flat 2D, hand-drawn picture-book cartoon cat with soft crayon/brush texture, not a realistic animal. The body is a huge, very plump, rounded mound, pale peach-cream (about #FFF2E6), with the legs mostly hidden. A warm charcoal cap covers the top of the head from the brow to the crown. The charcoal is a dark brownish grey, about #4C4140, not jet black. Small, rounded, pink ears (about #F7B9C3, paler pink inside) stick up at the edges of the cap. The eyes are ovals with a mustard/olive-gold iris (about #B59747) and a dark inner half. It has a tiny pink nose and long thin dark whiskers. Charcoal spots and patches run down the back to the hip. Seen from behind, the back patches spell the capital letters 'A', 'M', 'R', stacked down the spine, with small cream holes in the A and the R. This is its signature marking. The long fluffy charcoal tail has a cream-white tip and curls into a question-mark '?' hook. It wears nothing.

APOTHECAT.exactLook: This is an original cat, so our look text is the ground truth. A normal four-legged domestic shorthair, grey mackerel tabby. ATCHOUMCAT.realSource: Atchoum, a male Persian with congenital hypertrichosis, born 10 May 2014 and adopted by Nathalie, a groomer at a veterinary clinic in Repentigny, Quebec. He went viral in 2015 (Bored Panda) and is on Instagram as @atchoumthecat.
ATCHOUMCAT.exactLook: Atchoum is a male Persian with hypertrichosis. He has a flat Persian face with a small black nose and intense round amber eyes (copper-orange as a young cat, paler gold-amber as an adult) in a stern 'death stare'. Long, wiry, wispy silver-grey and white hairs sprout all over his head and face: bushy silver 'eyebrows' over the eyes, whisker-like cheek tufts and a long white-silver 'beard' under the chin, giving a mad-scientist or werewolf look. His small ears are almost hidden by long silver tufts. His coat is a smoke-and-white bicolour. The head and crown are noticeably lighter and silvery (the face hair is silver-white; as a young cat the skin around the eyes shows dark charcoal). The back, sides and tail are dark charcoal-black smoke in his 2015 viral photos, silvering to blue-grey smoke as an adult (2025). He has a white bib and chest, a white belly, white front paws and white hind feet. The fur is extremely long and shaggy all over, and the tail is bushy and dark. He is often photographed wearing a bow tie.

AZRAELCAT.realSource: Gargamel's cat in Peyo's The Smurfs (comics from 1959, Hanna-Barbera 1981 series, Smurfs: The Lost Village 2017, 2021 series). The official SmurfsMovie account posted his model sheet.
AZRAELCAT.exactLook: A Peyo-style 2D cartoon cat, matching the official SmurfsMovie model sheet (the comics, The Lost Village and the 2021 series look). He is lanky and skinny, with a long neck, long legs and big rounded paws. His fur is flat, bright red-orange (vermilion ginger) with NO tabby stripes, only a few ink fur-tuft lines. A big white muzzle and cheek patch surrounds the mouth and chin, and his throat, chest and belly are white. He has a black oval nose and big white oval eyes with small black pupils (NOT yellow), with heavy dark brow lines and a grumpy, over-it expression. A notch is torn out of the outer edge of his RIGHT ear (the viewer's left when he faces us), and his inner ears are pale pink-peach. He has a long, thin orange tail (fluffed and scruffy when startled), pale peach paw pads and black ink outlines, in a cel-shaded cartoon look. The 1981 Hanna-Barbera version is different: brown fur and yellow eyes.

BIGFROGGY.realSource: Big the Cat, SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog character (first in Sonic Adventure, 1998), a gentle fisherman who is always with his frog friend Froggy.
BIGFROGGY.exactLook: SEGA's 3D cartoon style, not a realistic animal. Big is a huge, rotund, bipedal anthropomorphic cat who stands upright like a person. His fur is lavender/violet-purple with dark violet stripes (rings) running up both arms and along a long tail, whose end is frayed into a spiky tuft. His feet are dark violet up to the ankles. Dark violet also covers the outer tips of his very large, long, triangular ears (which stick out sideways and have white insides), the top of his head, and rings round both eyes like a mask. White fur covers his huge round belly and torso, a spiky white chest and cheek ruff like a beard, and a protruding white muzzle. Eyes: small black pupils in large pale-yellow sclera. Small black nose. Outfit: tan/beige gloves, and a brown/tan belt with a large gold ring-shaped buckle (yellow belt in some modern renders). He wears brown sandals with silver buckles; some modern renders show dark violet straps with yellow soles. He carries a fishing rod with a red reel. Froggy is a small green frog with a pale yellow belly (with a tail in Sonic Adventure).

BODY: white chest, belly and legs with a black saddle over the back and flanks and a black tail (tuxedo). Short coat. On the flight she was strapped lying down in a padded restraint cradle inside a cylindrical container in the rocket's nose cone.

Her usual expression is a heavy-lidded, 'grumpy' squint. No collar or accessories are needed; she sometimes wore a thin pink collar, but it is not a signature item.

LACQUER.realName: 猫天天 (Mao Tiantian), the Tmall cat
LACQUER.realSource: The black-cat logo mascot of Alibaba's Tmall (天猫, 'Skycat'), introduced on 29 March 2012. Since 2020 Tmall has presented the character as 猫天天 (Mao Tiantian).
LACQUER.exactLook: The Tmall cat (猫天天), a flat 2D graphic mascot. It is solid pure black (no brown tint) with white features only. Head: an extremely wide, flat, rounded-rectangle head, about twice as wide as it is tall, forming the top bar of a letter 'T'. Two large wedge-shaped ears with slightly rounded tips rise at the outer top corners and sweep outward, and the top edge dips in a gentle concave curve between them. The lower corners of the head are rounded. Eyes: two big horizontal white ovals placed near the outer edges of the head. Each has a large, vertical, lens-shaped (spindle) black slit pupil that is centred in the eye and runs its full height. Nose: a small white downward-pointing triangle with rounded corners, centred between the eyes. Mouth (2014 and later): a short white vertical philtrum line under the nose, then a white 'ω'-shaped smile. Body (2019 full-body logo): a narrow black stem below the head forming the stroke of the 'T', with two short thin stick arms angled out to the sides. The stem splits at the bottom into two short legs with an inverted-V notch. No fur texture, no whiskers, no other colours. Brand context: Tmall red with the red 天猫 TMALL.COM wordmark. Plush and 3D versions keep the giant flat head, white eyes with centred black slit pupils, white triangle nose and small black T body.

ROSETTE.realSource: Apple's Mac OS X 10.2 'Jaguar' (announced 2002-05-06, released 2002-08-23), named after the big cat. Its official artwork is a serif capital 'X' covered in jaguar fur.
ROSETTE.exactLook: A real jaguar (Panthera onca), not a house cat. It is a heavy, muscular big cat with a broad, massive head, short thick legs, large paws and a fairly short tail. The coat is a rich golden-orange to amber on the back and flanks and is covered in large black rosettes: broken black rings with darker orange centres, many with one or two small black dots inside. The head, neck and legs carry solid black spots, with small dense spots on the face; there are no tabby 'M' stripes. The chin, throat, chest and belly are cream-white with bold black spots. The tail is spotted, turning into black rings toward a black tip. The eyes are golden-amber, the nose rosy-brown, and the ears small and rounded with black backs and a pale central spot. The only official Apple image is the Mac OS X Jaguar logo: a tall serif capital 'X' filled with this golden-orange, black-rosetted fur. The logo file has a transparent background, and Apple's Jaguar box art showed it on black.

Huge glossy turquoise/cyan eyes with white highlights and dark upper lash lines, a tiny pink nose, a ':3' mouth, and bright coral/orange-red inner ears with white ear tufts. Pink paw pads. The coin logo shows no outfit and no blush; the X avatar and other art add pink cheek blush. Other official art shows a white astronaut suit and helmet (website) and a blue knit turtleneck (current X avatar).

A realistic grey-and-white kitten instead of the anime cartoon. The coat is neutral grey (about rgb 91,88,88), not light blue-grey (about 158,187,205); the eyes are sky-blue, not glossy turquoise/cyan; the inner ears are pale pink, not coral-red. The model's head is covered by a grey fabric hood/beanie with a black 'V' on it; the forehead tabby mark was misread as a hat logo, and Wen wears no hood. The body is neutral grey (about rgb 70,71,74) instead of light blue-grey. The legs and paws are white, while official art shows blue-grey arms and paws. There is no ':3' mouth, and a striped tabby tail with a white tip was added. The turquoise eyes, coral inner ears and white chest/face are right.

WILLOWCAT.exactLook: Slim, long-legged young female domestic shorthair with large upright ears. She is a GREY MACKEREL TABBY with a warm taupe or fawn (brownish-grey) undertone, not cool silver-blue. She has dark grey mackerel stripes and broken bars on the flanks, clear dark bars on the legs, a ringed tail, and a tabby 'M' and fine lines on the forehead. The muzzle, chin and throat are pale cream-white, and the chest and belly are paler buff. There are no white paws: the paws are pale grey-buff. Eyes are yellow-green or chartreuse, and the nose is brick-pink with a dark rim.
